existing_tips: "Ska" for planned future events. "I sommar" means this/next summer.
"Skulle ha" + supine also = should have (in hindsight).
"Kommer att bli" = will become/get. "Bli" is the go-to verb for changes of state.
"Kommer att" + infinitive expresses predictions, especially weather and external events.
